name: jus-skills
description: The Juscribe Workflow SOP as two plugins: jus for Claude Code, with on-demand skills plus deterministic enforcement hooks, and juscribe for a Claude chat window, with the same skills plus the Juscribe connector.

plugins.name: jus
plugins.description: Juscribe Workflow SOP — ticket-workflow, hard-rules and retrospective skills backed by deterministic enforcement hooks.

plugins.name: juscribe
plugins.description: For a Claude chat window: the Juscribe connector plus the ticket-workflow, hard-rules and retrospective skills, in one install. No hooks, since chat has no shell.
